steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Sometimes this happens when I'm inventing little gadgets.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: When I really, really want to make it... When my will is strong enough... it's like there's a force helping me.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Those seemingly impossible experiments all succeeded in the end.
Eureka puts on her homemade roller shoes and runs around the factory with you in her arms, telling you about her discoveries. Pepper trails behind mindlessly.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Many times, the successes couldn't be explained scientifically... I later chalked them up to... hmm, there's a saying... what was it...

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Where there's a will, there's a way!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Oh? That sounds about right!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Mind over matter, to put it simply.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Especially for Sinners, a strong willpower can directly beget special powers...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Makes sense. Please continue.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Yep. I've met all kinds of toys along the way. But when I met that nesting doll, I realized, she is the most meticulously designed toy of all.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Being "meticulous" is kind of a "power" in itself.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: The more meticulous, the stronger?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eve was most meticulous about the toy family members, so they carry her deepest wish...

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: That's not all!

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Huh, there's more to it?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Compared to that, those little toys might not count for much.
She gasps for breath, pushing open a half-closed door at the end of the hallway...

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: What Eve is most meticulous about, and what carries her deepest wish, is much more dramatic than this!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What is this place?

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Oh, we stumbled upon this place by accident before!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: The factory boss's office.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then the power she used to blanket this place and create the toy world is...
You quickly understand what Eureka means. The power that consumes even herself to bring toys to life...

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: It's an ultra sincere and passionate wish that I don't even dare to think about.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: We've actually always been inside her creation!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: This entire factory is her creation!
The tranquil moonlight illuminates the humdrum office and the factory blueprint on the desk.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Has she been relying on her intense wish to support the toyification of the entire factory?! This place is huge! No wonder she's exhausted.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Right, so she must be extremely weak right now! The way to make this place normal again is simple.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Have another fight and drain her of her power. If she doesn't have the energy to keep transforming this place, the toyification will stop. Then we can all...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Cough, cough, cough, cough!

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Chief!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Why is Chief coming apart again? I clearly just patched things up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Good news...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We don't need to act. Eve might not be able to hold on much longer.
You watch as the cotton on your body rots and splits. Your body is recovering and reorganizing in a strange way.
Your consciousness becomes hazy, but only for a moment. You quickly come back to your senses.
You find that you have turned back to normal.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Chief, you're really impressive! You've beaten the enemy even without Pepper!
Pepper runs excitedly around your now normal body, gasping in awe.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Weren't you listening just now? It's not that I've defeated her, it's just that the factory is too much for Eve to handle.
Is this really the whole story? Was your guess really wrong? Does Eve's weakness really have nothing to do with the Underground?
You pat your firm, human-sized body, somewhat disbelieving at how smoothly everything is going.
Before you have time to think or celebrate your return to normalcy, a sudden commotion interrupts your thoughts.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Crowd
steps.content: I've turned back! I've turned back to normal!

steps.speaker: Chaotic Crowd
steps.content: Where am I? What year is it now?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: The commotion is coming from the workshop.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: What does this mean? We can leave now?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The factory's toyification stopped and reversed just like that? But we haven't done anything... Something's not right.
Based on the information you have now, Eve can't possibly have given up her wish... Oliver? No, that kid couldn't have done it either.
The power won't disappear for no reason... it will simply reappear in another form. Your ominous guess is immediately confirmed. A new type of commotion is erupting from all corners of the factory...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Crowd
steps.content: The door won't open! We're trapped!

steps.speaker: Chaotic Crowd
steps.content: Monster! There's some monster in the depot! Let us out!
Eve is mechanically moving between the shelves of the warehouse, numb and cold, like a real doll.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: This is my home, my family, all that I cherish... It can't be destroyed again...
<color=#dg1f1f>You're right! No one is allowed to do that!</color>
The black Mania mist whips up all the fallen toys and spirals upward around Eve. But she seems to have lost consciousness, and is repeating coldly over and over again...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: You'll help me, won't you...
<color=#dg1f1f>Of course! Give me your sorrow... and I'll give you power! Power that no one can stop! Give me... give me...</color>

The contamination spreads along her ankles, hair, and limbs. The toys infused with contamination gradually lose control as the black mist surges and spreads. More and more toys in the warehouse are moving towards Eve, devouring her bit by bit.
